bibliographic.title: MoP3SiO11 : a 4d3 honeycomb antiferromagnet with disconnected octahedra

bibliographic.abstract: We report the crystal structure and magnetic behavior of the 4 d3 spin-3/2 silicophosphate MoP3SiO11 studied by high-resolution synchrotron x-ray diffraction, neutron diffraction, thermodynamic measurements, and ab initio band-structure calculations. Our data revise the crystallographic symmetry of this compound and establish its rhombohedral space group ( R̄ 3 c ) along with the geometrically perfect honeycomb lattice of the Mo3+ ions residing in disconnected MoO6 octahedra. Long-range antiferromagnetic order with the propagation vector k = 0 observed below TN = 6 . 8 K is a combined effect of the nearest-neighbor in-plane exchange coupling J ≈ 2 . 6 K, easy-plane singleion anisotropy D ≈ 2 . 2 K, and a weak interlayer coupling Jc ≈ 0 . 8 K. The 12% reduction in the ordered magnetic moment of the Mo3+ ions and the magnon gap of Δ ≈ 7 K induced by the singleion anisotropy further illustrate the impact of spin-orbit coupling on the magnetism. Our analysis puts forward single-ion anisotropy as an important ingredient of 4 d3 honeycomb antiferromagnets despite their nominally quenched orbital moment.

samples.sample_description: Phase-pure polycrystalline samples prepared by a two-step solid-state reaction.

datasets.dataset_description: High-resolution XRD data collected at room temperature to verify rhombohedral symmetry.
Neutron diffraction data collected at 1.5 K and 295 K to determine crystal and magnetic structure.
Temperature-dependent magnetic susceptibility measured in applied fields up to 7 T.
Magnetization measurements up to 56 T performed at 1.4 K.
Heat capacity measured in the temperature range of 1 . 8 – 300 K in magnetic fields up to 14 T.
